change.title: pr-6
change.description: UX: show complete URL path if website domain is same as instance domain
change.author: Arpit Jalan

findings.title: website_name leaks the website of TL0 users that `website` hides
findings.body: `website` is in `untrusted_attributes` (lines 105-111), so anonymous viewers of a TL0 user get no `website` (`restrict_user_fields?`, line 29). `website_name` is not in that list. It is derived from the same value, and its only gate, `include_website_name` (line 153), checks `website.present?`, which is the raw accessor. So the host and path of the hidden website are still serialized to anonymous viewers. The profile template now renders `model.website_name` (user.hbs:66-71) with no check on `model.website`, so the hidden host is shown on the page. This undoes the spam protection that `untrusted_attributes` provides. Add `:website_name` to `untrusted_attributes`, and add `website_name` to the `untrusted_attributes` list in the spec (line 11) so it is covered.

findings.title: Profile shows a stale website name after the website is edited
findings.body: `websiteName` was a computed property on `model.website`, so editing the website in preferences updated the profile at once. `website_name` is now a server-computed field, and `User.save` only copies `bio_excerpt` from the PUT response (models/user.js.es6:210). The preferences `save` action does not refresh it either (controllers/preferences.js.es6:117-121). After a user changes or clears their website and returns to their profile, the old `website_name` is still shown. When the website is cleared it still renders a globe icon and a link with an empty href. This silently shows wrong data until a full reload. Fix it by setting `website_name` from `data.user.website_name` in the `save` callback (models/user.js.es6:210). Because of the missing `?` and the untrusted filtering above, the key may be absent from the response, so the callback must also handle that.

findings.title: website_name drops the port and compares hosts case-sensitively
findings.body: The old JS used `website.split('/')[2]`, which kept any port (`example.com:8080`). `URI#host` drops it, so those sites now display without the port. `URI#host` also keeps the original case. A website entered as `http://Example.com/x` will not equal the lowercase `Discourse.current_hostname`, so the path is silently not shown. Downcase `website_host` before comparing.

findings.title: Sibling-domain heuristic is wrong for multi-label public suffixes and hard to read
findings.body: The branch at line 144 treats two hosts as related when they have the same label count (more than 2) and the same suffix after the first label. For `a.co.uk` and `b.co.uk` the suffix `co.uk` matches, so the full path of an unrelated site is shown. Line 149 builds its suffix with `"." << website_host`, which is a mutating append that is easy to misread. `".#{website_host}"` is clearer. The three branches also repeat `URI(website.to_s)` several times. Parse the URI once and extract the comparison into a small helper.

findings.title: Missing coverage for sibling-subdomain, no-website and TL0-anonymous cases
findings.body: The three new examples cover the unrelated-domain, same-domain and parent-domain cases only. Nothing covers the `www.example.com` versus `forum.example.com` branch (line 144), an invalid or scheme-less website, or an empty website where `website_name` should be absent. The untrusted-attributes example (line 11) does not list `website_name`, which is why the leak above went unnoticed.

contracts.action: Profile page renders the server-computed website_name instead of the client-computed websiteName
contracts.equivalent_path: Removed controller property websiteName (website.split('/')[2], derived from model.website). The preferences-save path model.save() in app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/user.js.es6.
contracts.before_after: Before: the name was recomputed from model.website on every change, so it was always in sync with the website and was empty whenever the website was hidden or blank. After: the name comes from the JSON loaded with the user, and model.save only updates bio_excerpt from the response (models/user.js.es6:210), so it is not refreshed after an edit. Also, website_name is not filtered for restricted TL0 viewers.
contracts.visible_effect: The profile shows a stale website name after an edit, shows the website host of a TL0 user to anonymous viewers, and can show a globe icon with an empty link after the website is cleared.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent wrong data, with no error and no visible state to flag it.

summary: The change moves the website display name from a client-side computed property to a new `website_name` serializer field. There are two serializer bugs and one stale-state bug. `website_name` is missing from `untrusted_attributes`, so it exposes the website of TL0 users that `website` hides from anonymous viewers. The gate method is named `include_website_name` without `?`, so it is never called. The profile no longer updates `website_name` after the website is edited, so a stale name stays visible. There are also smaller issues with the port and case handling, the sibling-domain heuristic, and test coverage.
